name: brawlPvpBalanceObjects
description:
Modified pvp balance objects used by template Brawl, should be better suited for short games on small maps:
Crypt: 3x8/2x10/10/10 Skeletons, 2x5/2x5/5/5 Walking Deads, 0/0/3/3 Wights, 0/0/1/2 Vampires, rewards: Treasure class Artifact, 799-999 Gold, 0-2 Wights.
Imp Cache: 5x 10-20 Imps, reward: 2-4 Mercury, 500-1000 Gold, 4 Gogs/3 Hell Hounds/2 Demons/1 Pit Fiend,
Cons have guards from 1-5 to 4-8 griffins, rewards 2-5 Monks, each stack can be upgraded, revisitable after 4 days,
Hives have guards from 1-5 to 4-8 Lizardmen, reward 4-7 Serpent Flies, also revisitable after 4 days and also each stack can be upgraded,
Red Tower: 5x 2-5 water elementals, reward 3-6 air elementals,
Experimental Workshop: 5x 2 Stone-Gold Golems, reward: 5 Venomous Wadjets/3 Camel Riders/3 Desert Warriors/2 Ammuts,
Wolf Rider Picket: 4x 6-12 Goblins and 6-12 Wolf Riders, reward: 2-3 Wood and Ore and 3-6 Orcs,
Ruins: value up to 3000, rarity down to 50, zone limit down to 1, revisitable like the rest, guards and rewards untouched.
Mansion: 5-8 Vampire Lords, reward: minor art, 2-3 resources, 1200-1800 gold,
Ziggurat: defended by 3-5x 1 Sphinx, reward: 1500-2500 Gold, 4-8 Crystals and Gems, 2-4 Spells from different Schools
The Snake Temple Creature Bank is left as it is. It's power is actually okay as a rare slightly (but not too much!) bigger non-rechargable bank.
Bone Pillar: defended by 7x 1-3 Ghosts, reward: 1000-2000 Gold, 2-4 Ghosts
Outpost of Souls: defended by 7x 1-2 Power Liches, reward: 1 Demilich or Minor Phylactery
Scriptorium: defended by 5x 1-3 Monks (guard count lowered 10 times), rewards (Gold rewards halved, rest of rewards left untouched): 1/2/3/4 Gems, 0/2/3/4 Crystals, 0/0/3/4 Sulfur and 0/0/0/4 Mercury, a Level 1 or 2 Spell, 1250/1625/2000/2750 Gold, Artifacts: none/Minor/Minor/Treasure+Major
Seminarium: defended by 5x 6/8/10 Pikemen, rewards: 3/4/5 Swordmen or 1 Templar instead of the 5 Swordmen
Sorceress Castle: guarded by 3/4 Tritons, 2/0 Mermaids, 2/3 Dryads, 2/3 Succubi, 2/3 Werewolves, 1/2 Illithids, 1/2 Troll Hag and 0/1 Coatl, rewards: a Level 3 Spell, a Level 2 or 4 Spell, a Statue of Legion component, a Coruncopia component or a Golden Goose component or Wood and Ore Carts
Demon Domain: 2x 1 Pit Lord and 3 stacks of 9 Imps/3 Gogs/2 Dogs/1 Demon, rewards: 2 Fire/3 Fire/2 Energy/3 Energy Elementals,
Dragon Utopia: 3 out of 4 Dragons, namely 1 Red Dragon, 1 Green Dragon, 1 Bone Dragon, 1 Dragon Golem, reward: Treasure, Minor and Major Artifacts and 3000 Gold,
Golden Dragon Utopia: 1 Red Dragon, 1 Green Dragon, 1 Bone Dragon, 1 Dragon Golem or 1 Faerie Dragon instead of those 4, reward: Treasure, Minor, Major and Relic Artifacts, 4000 Gold and 6 of each Resource and Dimension Door spell for 1 turn.
All creatures that have upgrades, both guards and rewards have a chance of being upgraded.
All banks recharge after 4 full days pass.
They are not designed to be taken with your whole army but with parts of your army in multiple places at once.
Pit Lords can Raise Demons twice per battle.
Densities of Treasures in Water Zones up to 5/10/20 in the intervals with high/intermediate/low treasure values. Repeated from main Brawl mod to overwrite changes from PvP Balance. In case someone wants to play with Water, especially with Water-themed mods.
author: Warzyw647

1.0: repeated bank changes from other submods in banks modified by pvp-balance
drastically increased treasure densities in Water Zones
1.01: smaller versions of Dragon Utopia and Golden Dragon Utopia
1.02: added Dimension Door spell for 1 turn to list of rewards for Golden Dragon Utopia
